title: The Institutional Window: Occupation- and Jurisdiction-Specific Calibration of Liability Signaling for Preserved Human Fallback Capability
abstract: arXiv:2608.05969v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative AI makes expert output uninformative about the human fallback capability its provider keeps in reserve. A liability commitment can signal that capability: a provider whose staff rescue more of the cases the AI fails pays damages less often, so the commitment certifies an asset built by keeping people on cases and lost by taking them off. This paper asks where contract law leaves room for such a signal. Four legal primitives map a posted cap into retained exposure and close the message space from both sides: litigation viability, the penalty doctrine, displacement of liability to the state or an indemnity pool, and mandatory control of standard terms. translated_title: 制度之窗：面向保留人类后备能力的责任信号传递在职业与司法辖区层面的特定校准
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能使得专家产出不再能反映其提供者所保留的人类后备能力。责任承诺可以传递这种能力的信号：其员工能挽救更多AI失败案例的提供者，支付损害赔偿的频率更低，因此这一承诺证明了一种通过让人员持续参与案件而积累、因将人员撤出案件而流失的资产。本文探讨合同法在何处为这种信号留出空间。四项法律基本要素——诉讼可行性、罚金条款规则、责任向国家或赔偿基金的转移、以及对标准条款的强制性规制——将公示的责任上限映射为留存的风险敞口，并从两端封闭了信息空间。在法律保留零风险敞口选项的地方，低类型在零处混同，中间类型在以强制下限为锚点的责任表上实现分离，高类型在上限处混同；在不存在该选项的地方，分离从最低类型即开始。法定下限消除了较低的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文构建信号博弈模型，揭示合同法的四项法律要素如何因职业与司法辖区而异，划定了责任上限承诺能否可信传递生成式AI提供者所保留人类后备能力的“制度之窗”，并刻画了不同法律环境下低、中、高能力类型 provider 的混同与分离均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper models how four contract-law doctrines—varying by occupation and jurisdiction—define an "institutional window" in which liability caps can credibly signal a generative-AI provider's preserved human fallback capability, producing pooling or separating equilibria depending on whether a zero-exposure option remains available.
